assumptions: Thin paraxial lens, with unchanged surface geometry and a homogeneous exterior on both sides.
Use unit refractive index for the stated air reference.

expected.nearMatchingIndex: withhold numerically unresolved finite focal length

relation: Calibrate the shared curvature factor from the reference medium and signed focal length. Transfer (nLens-nMedium) times that factor to each new exterior. The image-side focal length includes the new medium index in its numerator.

syntheticNativeControl.required: One native entrance, one native exit, and a downstream detector crossing for each ray. Independently predict the rear-pole intercept of the actual finite-thickness lens; require residual less than 0.5 mm and mirrored-intercept disagreement less than 0.01 mm. The source focal lengths are separate analytical thin values.
